53621E04276243B6A406F4DDD99DDDC7.description: Use polynomial identities to solve problems.

5F1FE9CF86B44DD7BD76772015831DA9.description: (+) Derive the equation of a parabola given a focus and directrix.

60D3451E6425426AABFE3AC707817A8E.description: Represent complex numbers and their operations on the complex plane.

612B89D750A54464AF390DE0F93F91B4.description: Apply geometric concepts in modeling situations.
